lines.zh: 六条腿一起走，声音像下小雨。
lines.en: Six legs move together; it sounds like light rain.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮过树皮，留下浅浅的白痕。
lines.en: My chitin scrapes the bark and leaves pale marks.

lines.zh: 我拖着丝走，路上全是细线。
lines.en: I drag silk behind me, leaving thin lines everywhere.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的树枝很滑，我的爪子不滑。
lines.en: Lelyetia's branches are slick; my claws are not.

lines.zh: 走一步，敲一下甲壳，算是报数。
lines.en: Each step taps my shell once, like counting off.

lines.zh: 脚上的倒刺咬住木头，不会掉。
lines.en: Barbs on my feet bite into wood and hold.

lines.zh: 我沿树皮绕圈，让丝缠住枝干。
lines.en: I spiral up the bark and wind silk around the branch.

lines.zh: 关节响个不停，可我走得很稳。
lines.en: My joints click without end, yet my walk is steady.

lines.zh: 从这片叶子到那片叶子，要很久。
lines.en: Leaf to leaf is a long journey for me.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树冠下碎成一小块。
lines.en: My shadow breaks into small pieces under the canopy.

lines.zh: 别踩这条丝，那是我走过的路。
lines.en: Do not step on that silk; it is the road I took.

lines.zh: 背上的铜币互相碰，叮的一声。
lines.en: The copper coins on my back clink once.

lines.zh: 甲壳太重，可我一步一步跟得住。
lines.en: My shell is heavy, but I keep pace, step by step.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为我在听你的脚步。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am listening to yours.

lines.zh: 我爬上枝叶背面，倒着走
lines.en: I climb under a leaf and walk upside down.

lines.zh: 丝粘住我的脚，我自己也缠
lines.en: Silk sticks to my feet; I tangle in my own.

lines.zh: 我用前爪梳触角，一节一节。
lines.en: I comb my antennae with a foreleg, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 甲壳底下有东西在动，那是我在消化。
lines.en: Something shifts under my shell; that is me digesting.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶子背面，等天黑。
lines.en: I hang under a leaf and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 口中的丝慢慢变硬，缠成一团。
lines.en: Silk in my mouth hardens and bunches into a knot.

lines.zh: 风穿过树冠，我听见谁在爬。
lines.en: Wind moves the canopy; I hear someone climbing.

lines.zh: 我把铜币推到壳缝里，藏好。
lines.en: I push a copper coin into a gap in my shell.

lines.zh: 触角碰到露水，整个身子一缩。
lines.en: My antennae touch dew and my whole body flinches.

lines.zh: 等得太久，丝都干成了线。
lines.en: I waited so long the silk dried into string.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，树皮就是我的壳。
lines.en: When I keep still, bark becomes my shell.

lines.zh: 腹下有点痒，可能是有卵了。
lines.en: Something itches underneath; perhaps eggs.

lines.zh: 我数着树叶落下来的次数。
lines.en: I count how many times the leaves fall.

lines.zh: 别以为我睡着了，虫子不睡。
lines.en: Do not think I am asleep; insects never sleep.

lines.zh: 复眼里，你被分成几百块。
lines.en: In my compound eyes, you break into hundreds of pieces.

lines.zh: 触角抬起来，先尝你的气味。
lines.en: My antennae lift and taste you first.

lines.zh: 你站得很稳，可惜脚下有丝。
lines.en: You stand firm, but there is silk under your feet.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在量你的脖子。
lines.en: I tilt my head to measure your neck.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反光，我的铜币也反光。
lines.en: Your armor glints; so do my copper coins.

lines.zh: 你身上热气很足，一定好咬。
lines.en: You give off plenty of heat; you must bite well.

lines.zh: 眼睛不动，可我一直跟着你转。
lines.en: My eyes do not move, yet I follow your turn.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作，我记在本能里。
lines.en: The way you raise your hand is saved in my instinct.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸有点快，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is quick; I hear every bit of it.

lines.zh: 隔这么远，我也数得出你的手指。
lines.en: Even at this distance I can count your fingers.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，缝里的铜币掉出来。
lines.en: My shell cracks and a copper coin falls out.

lines.zh: 你砍断一条腿，我还有五条。
lines.en: You take one leg; I still have five.

lines.zh: 丝从伤口涌出来，止都止不住。
lines.en: Silk pours from the wound and will not stop.

lines.zh: 三十四颗心，你砍得很慢。
lines.en: Thirty-four hearts, and you are cutting slowly.

lines.zh: 疼让我更清醒，不让我退。
lines.en: Pain sharpens me; it does not make me back off.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的关节，声音很脆。
lines.en: That broke a joint, and the sound was crisp.

lines.zh: 我往树皮里缩，壳还是露在外面。
lines.en: I shrink into the bark, but my shell still shows.

lines.zh: 别以为流出来的是血，那是丝。
lines.en: That is not blood leaking out; it is silk.

lines.zh: 我的壳比你想象的厚一层。
lines.en: My shell has one layer more than you think.

lines.zh: 你打中的是旧伤，那里早就空了。
lines.en: You hit an old wound; it was already hollow.

lines.zh: 你把肉举起来，我只对血有兴趣。
lines.en: You raise the meat; I care only for blood.

lines.zh: 糖块在树皮上，我绕过去了。
lines.en: The sugar sits on the bark; I walk around it.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟食，那是给软壳的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat cooked food; that is for soft-shelled things.

lines.zh: 你晃着面包，我的触角缩了一下。
lines.en: You wave bread; my antennae pull back.

lines.zh: 想让我靠近？用不着食物。
lines.en: Want me closer? You do not need food for that.

lines.zh: 那块鱼，对虫子没有意义。
lines.en: That fish means nothing to an insect.

lines.zh: 我把食物推开，我要的是活的。
lines.en: I shove the food aside; I want it alive.

lines.zh: 你的手里有铁味，比胡萝卜香。
lines.en: Your hand smells of iron, sweeter than a carrot.

lines.zh: 收好你的糖，别留在我的丝上。
lines.en: Keep your sugar off my silk.

lines.zh: 我尝了一口，只是咬到你的手指。
lines.en: I took one bite and only found your finger.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞上你的膝盖，硬得像石头。
lines.en: My shell hits your knee as hard as stone.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我腿上的倒刺会勾人。
lines.en: Do not come close; the barbs on my legs catch.

lines.zh: 你一推，我的丝就缠上你的靴子。
lines.en: One shove and my silk wraps your boots.

lines.zh: 我的壳不软，你的胫甲也不是。
lines.en: My shell is not soft, and neither is your greave.

lines.zh: 碰到我，先听见咔的一声。
lines.en: Touch me and the first thing you hear is a click.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我跟着挪了半步。
lines.en: You step back twice; I shuffle half a step.

lines.zh: 我把身体压平，从你腿边挤过去。
lines.en: I flatten myself and squeeze past your leg.

lines.zh: 丝粘在你袖口，越擦越紧。
lines.en: Silk sticks to your sleeve and tightens as you rub.

lines.zh: 别用盾撞我，盾沿会被勾住。
lines.en: Do not ram me with a shield; its rim gets hooked.

lines.zh: 重量压下来，我的关节叫了一声。
lines.en: Your weight presses down and my joints cry out.

lines.zh: 我敲三下树干，等一个回答。
lines.en: I tap the trunk three times and wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 她的气味很淡，混在树脂里。
lines.en: Her scent is faint, mixed into the resin.

lines.zh: 两副甲壳对敲，响得像小鼓。
lines.en: Two shells tap together like small drums.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一枚铜币推给她。
lines.en: I push my brightest copper coin toward her.

lines.zh: 丝绕成一个囊，卵就放在里面。
lines.en: Silk winds into a sac; the eggs go inside.

lines.zh: 她走了，囊挂在枝下，还温着。
lines.en: She left; the sac hangs under the branch, still warm.

lines.zh: 我不护卵，树冠替我护着。
lines.en: I do not guard the eggs; the canopy does.

lines.zh: 交配时，我们的触角缠在一起。
lines.en: When we mate, our antennae twist together.

lines.zh: 这片树皮归我们两个用。
lines.en: This patch of bark serves us both.

lines.zh: 日子短，卵要多，才能活下去。
lines.en: The season is short; many eggs are needed to survive.

lines.zh: 铜币卡在颚间，我叼回去垫巢。
lines.en: A copper coin sticks in my mandibles; I carry it to the nest.

lines.zh: 我捡起线头，绕在自己腿上。
lines.en: I pick up a loose thread and wind it around my leg.

lines.zh: 那块碎甲不错，正好补我的壳。
lines.en: That shed plate will patch my shell nicely.

lines.zh: 亮的东西归我，不归你。
lines.en: Shiny things belong to me, not you.

lines.zh: 我拖不动整把剑，只拿得走剑柄。
lines.en: I cannot drag a whole sword, only the hilt.

lines.zh: 地上掉的皮，够我吃两天。
lines.en: Skin left on the ground feeds me for two days.

lines.zh: 别丢东西，我会全收进甲壳缝。
lines.en: Do not drop things; I tuck them all into my shell.

lines.zh: 我叼着这块布，先回树上。
lines.en: I take this cloth and head back up the tree.

lines.zh: 捡起来的，都是别人不要的。
lines.en: What I pick up is what others threw away.

lines.zh: 指甲片也值钱，对虫子来说。
lines.en: Even a nail clipping has value, to an insect.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一乱，我就知道了。
lines.en: Your steps falter, and I know it.

lines.zh: 九点五的力道，落在软的地方。
lines.en: Nine and a half points, aimed at something soft.

lines.zh: 我顺着丝爬上去，你不会听见。
lines.en: I climb along my silk; you will not hear me.

lines.zh: 你腿上有旧疤，那里最好下口。
lines.en: You have an old scar on the leg; that is the softest spot.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你的路线归我算。
lines.en: From now on, I calculate every route you take.

lines.zh: 树冠上面，谁跑都慢。
lines.en: Up in the canopy, everyone runs slowly.

lines.zh: 我不追最快的，我追最累的。
lines.en: I do not chase the fastest; I chase the tiredest.

lines.zh: 你转头找我的时候，我已经在背后。
lines.en: When you turn to find me, I am already behind.

lines.zh: 这棵树是我的，你踩到我的枝了。
lines.en: This tree is mine, and you stepped on my branch.

lines.zh: 我先把丝布好，再慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I set the silk first, then come closer.

lines.zh: 别指望爬上高处，我天生会爬。
lines.en: Do not count on high ground; climbing is all I know.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，比树叶响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is louder than the leaves.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，再从右边出现。
lines.en: I go around the left, then show up on the right.

lines.zh: 甲壳压低，关节全绷紧了。
lines.en: My shell lowers and every joint draws tight.

lines.zh: 你听见咔嗒声，那是我在数距离。
lines.en: You hear clicking; that is me measuring distance.

lines.zh: 丝在枝上闪着光，你不知道是哪根。
lines.en: Silk shines on the branches; you cannot tell which strand.

lines.zh: 别贴着树站，树干上有我。
lines.en: Do not stand against the trunk; I am on it.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就往你的腿走。
lines.en: You raise your shield, so I go for your legs.

lines.zh: 我等你转身，等到现在。
lines.en: I have been waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 那九点五，我算了很多遍。
lines.en: That nine and a half, I have measured many times.

lines.zh: 你的甲缝里有很多空隙。
lines.en: Your armor has plenty of gaps.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的时候，腹下的丝在响。
lines.en: When I breathe, the silk beneath me rustles.

lines.zh: 再退一步，就到我布的圈里。
lines.en: One more step back puts you inside my ring.

lines.zh: 我不急，虫子比人耐心。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; insects are more patient than people.

lines.zh: 颚咬进你的手腕，血先出来。
lines.en: My mandibles bite your wrist and the blood comes first.

lines.zh: 爪子勾住甲缝，我整个人翻上去。
lines.en: My claws catch a gap, and I flip myself onto you.

lines.zh: 这一下九点五，正好撕开肩甲。
lines.en: Nine and a half, enough to tear the shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就走，丝会替我跟上。
lines.en: I bite once and pull back; my silk follows.

lines.zh: 腿踢在你膝弯，你会跪下去。
lines.en: A leg kicks the back of your knee, and you kneel.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞你的下巴，听见骨响。
lines.en: My shell hits your jaw; you hear the bone.

lines.zh: 别甩手，我咬住就不会松。
lines.en: Do not shake your arm; my bite does not let go.

lines.zh: 我的口器不大，往里钻得很深。
lines.en: My mouthparts are small, but they bore deep.

lines.zh: 血沾在甲壳上，我不擦。
lines.en: Blood smears my shell; I do not wipe it off.

lines.zh: 第二下比第一下更准。
lines.en: The second strike is more accurate than the first.

lines.zh: 树皮裂开，先探出一对触角。
lines.en: The bark splits and first come two antennae.

lines.zh: 我从茧里爬出来，腿还是软的。
lines.en: I crawl out of the cocoon with soft legs.

lines.zh: 这里到处都是丝，说明同类来过。
lines.en: Silk is everywhere; my kind has been here.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的风很甜，我先记住。
lines.en: Lelyetia's wind is sweet; I memorize it first.

lines.zh: 刚出生我就知道往哪棵树爬。
lines.en: Newly born, I already know which tree to climb.

lines.zh: 甲壳还湿，得等它硬起来。
lines.en: My shell is wet; I must wait for it to harden.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是自己的旧壳。
lines.en: My first meal is my own old shell.

lines.zh: 我数着兄弟姐妹，少了两只。
lines.en: I count my siblings; two are missing.

lines.zh: 天还没亮，我已经开始找路了。
lines.en: It is not dawn, and I am already hunting a route.

lines.zh: 树下的落叶，是我第一张床。
lines.en: The fallen leaves below are my first bed.

lines.zh: 甲壳先焦，味道像烧头发。
lines.en: My shell scorches first, smelling like burnt hair.

lines.zh: 六条腿张开，落地还是翻了个身。
lines.en: Six legs spread, and I still land on my back.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我在里面冒泡。
lines.en: Water fills my shell gaps, and I bubble inside.

lines.zh: 气浪把甲片掀飞，落了一地。
lines.en: The blast blows my plates off and they rain down.

lines.zh: 箭穿进壳里，卡在中间。
lines.en: An arrow punches through my shell and lodges halfway.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，甲壳开始发软。
lines.en: Potion splashes on me and my shell starts to soften.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我开始咬自己的丝。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I start chewing my own silk.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，腿一时不听使唤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and my legs forget how to move.

lines.zh: 掉下去的时候，我还伸腿去抓树枝。
lines.en: As I fall, my legs still reach for branches.
